g.text: SportsCal uses a dark neutral base, high contrast text, and restrained status accents.
Geist carries interface and display copy. Geist Mono labels data, metadata, and tokens.
Pick a team, tune how games appear, and subscribe to a feed.
No accounts, no ads in your events.
Schedule data sourced from ESPN public endpoints.
A 4 px base scale supports compact controls and generous page sections.
Use hairline borders to separate surfaces. Reserve focus rings for interaction.
